x: Three other runners had Belgrave connections however; Jack Brown (Cambridge H) was 7th in the over 50 race, while in the over 40s Gerry North (Portsmouth) was 19th and Bill Dance (Longwood) 72nd.
A final selection race for the Southern Road Relay with Derek Crookes unable to make it thereby relying on his 5¾ run for selection. Gerry North running for Portsmouth clocked 19.02.

Overtaking Bill Clapham on the last lap, Charlie finished strongly in third place in the over 60's, within sight of Laurie Forster. He was also was pleased to meet Gerry North who ran to help his team, Portsmouth although out of sorts.
